# A2H Agency

> AI Receptionist + CRM for Texas local service businesses, with hand-coded custom websites available as an upgrade. Answers every call, books the visit, and tracks every call and caller in a custom CRM.

A2H builds an AI phone receptionist and CRM for businesses that lose revenue to missed calls: dental practices, orthodontic practices and non-medical home care agencies in Texas. A2H answers every call, books the visit, and tracks every call and caller in a custom CRM. It handles scheduling only, never clinical data. Pricing is covered on a free 15-minute call.

## Pricing
- AI Receptionist + CRM: $1,500 one-time setup, then $397/month. Answers every call, books appointments, logs every contact in a CRM pipeline. Cancel anytime.
- AI Receptionist + CRM + Custom Website: $2,000 one-time setup, then $400/month. Adds a hand-coded website (up to 10 pages) and Google Business Profile setup.
- Extra CRM seat: $99/month per seat.
- AI Website Chatbot add-on: $99/month (Custom Website tier only).
- Care Plan (hosting, maintenance, monthly content edits): $249/month, included with Custom Website tier, cancel anytime.
